verdict.rationale: Attio documents an official MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT or other AI tools search, update and manage the workspace. Its public REST API reads and writes workspace records, and it ships a standard Deal object, so an agent can update deal records. Its own AI captures call transcripts and buying signals and promotes updating records and scheduling next steps. missing for 10: explicit docs on updating the deal stage attribute via API/MCP, evidence that email and meeting/transcript signals are readable through the API or MCP, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
